description: This source file implements missile impact handling, missile spawning, and fire spawning logic for the game Unvanquished, including impact effects, damage calculations, and fire entity creation.

methods.name: BounceMissile
methods.description: Handles missile bouncing logic upon impact with surfaces.

methods.name: MissileTimePowerMod
methods.description: Calculates missile attribute modifications over time based on specified modulation type.

methods.name: MissileTimeDmgMod
methods.description: Returns damage modifier based on missile type and lifetime.

methods.name: G_MissileTimeSplashDmgMod
methods.description: Returns splash damage modifier based on missile type and lifetime.

methods.name: ImpactGrenade
methods.description: Impact behavior for grenade-type missiles, including bouncing.

methods.name: ImpactFlamer
methods.description: Impact behavior for flamer missiles, including ignition and fire setting.

methods.name: ImpactFirebombSub
methods.description: Impact behavior for firebomb sub-missiles, igniting target and environment.

methods.name: ImpactLockblock
methods.description: Impact behavior for lockblock missiles, applying lock effects to human targets.

methods.name: ImpactSlowblob
methods.description: Impact behavior for slowblob missiles, extinguishing fires and applying slow effects.

methods.name: ImpactHive
methods.description: Impact behavior for hive missiles, damaging only humans.

methods.name: G_MissileImpact
methods.description: Handles missile impact logic, including bounce, damage, effects, and cleanup.

methods.name: G_SetUpMissile
methods.description: Initializes missile entity properties and trajectory.

methods.name: G_SpawnDumbMissile
methods.description: Spawns a non-guided missile entity with specified parameters.

methods.name: G_SpawnFire
methods.description: Creates a fire entity at a specified location and normal, with fire effects.
